rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for work, searches, or checking done with precise attention to detail.

example.english: I was meticulous when I checked the report, so I didn't miss any details.
example.traditional: 我仔細咁睇過份報告，冇漏任何細節。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 sai3 gam3 tai2 gwo3 fan6 bou3 gou3 mou5 lau6 jam6 ho4 sai3 zit3

rows.note: Use this especially for a person who is attentive and careful about details.

example.english: Ming is meticulous at work and remembers even the customers' little requests.
example.traditional: 阿明做嘢好細心，連客人嘅小要求都記得。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1 lin4 haak3 jan4 ge3 siu2 jiu3 kau4 dou1 gei3 dak1
